title: Characterization of dead vertices
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a valid output vertex. A vertex belongs to the list of dead vertices exactly when it is less than the circuit size, is not the output vertex, and is read by no gate.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a valid output vertex
